benefits_features_and_faqs.about_overview: RBL NOVA Credit Card is a premium offering which allows the cardholders to accrue good value-back primarily through its rewards program and travel benefits. With up to 6% savings on travel, with luxury stay gift cards and complimentary airport lounge access for card users and guests, this card can be a decent companion for travel enthusiasts. However, to make the most of the high rewards rate on travel, cardholders will have to restrict themselves to a dedicated RBL platform to make their flight and hotel bookings.

faqs.q: What is the forex mark-up fee on RBL NOVA Credit Card spends?
faqs.a: You are charged with a 2% forex mark-up on international spends made using RBL Bank NOVA Credit Card.

faqs.q: Does RBL NOVA offer accelerated rewards with 6% back on all travel spends?
faqs.a: No, you can earn 12 reward points per Rs. 100 spent , i.e. 6% value-back only on travel bookings made using nova.rbl.bank.in.

faqs.q: Can I take guests with me to the airport lounge for free using RBL NOVA Credit Card?
faqs.a: Yes, RBL NOVA Credit Card comes with 4 complimentary visits for guests every year, however this guest access is limited to airport lounges outside India.

faqs.q: What is the milestone bonus that I can earn in a year using RBL NOVA Credit Card?
faqs.a: You can earn gift cards worth up to Rs. 40,000 as milestone bonus every year, where you get Rs. 10,000 gift card on Rs. 3 lakh quarterly spends.

faqs.q: What are the benefits offered by RBL NOVA Credit Card, apart from travel and rewards?
faqs.a: You can get complimentary golf access, dining discount and milestone bonus as gift cards with RBL NOVA Credit Card.
